body: A generative speech model for daily dialogue.
plain_description: ChatTTS brings natural, expressive voice to conversational AI applications like chatbots and virtual assistants. It's purpose-built for dialogue, letting you control tone, laughter, and pauses in generated speech. The bottom line: add lifelike voice output to your AI products without building a TTS system from scratch.
technical_description: ChatTTS is an open-source text-to-speech model optimized for dialogue-based synthesis. It uses an autoregressive architecture with a DVAE encoder and supports fine-grained prosodic control including laughter, pauses, and interjections via special tokens. The model is trained on over 100,000 hours of Chinese and English audio, with a 40,000-hour pre-trained checkpoint available on HuggingFace. It provides a Python API via PyPI, supports GPU acceleration on NVIDIA hardware, and includes a WebUI for interactive use.
title: ChatTTS
